rationale: Extend the existing resolved applicability finding so its already-existing claim-boundary limitation is also represented as a governed customer_qualification semantic attribute with the same approved evidence lineage. This allows the existing Explanation/Response/HumanAnswer typed customer-qualification path to expose the customer-relevant boundary while raw planner/evidence diagnostics remain available only through provenance.
supersession_impact: No reasoning rule, timeline algorithm, decision policy, explanation contract, or human projection behavior is replaced. The existing raw finding limitation is preserved unchanged for safety and audit; this change only adds typed semantic classification for an already-governed qualification.
authority_impact: No new insurance conclusion, claim approval/payment authority, or product-specific behavior is introduced. The repair re-expresses an existing limitation through the governed semantic-attribute channel so customer communication can distinguish it from internal diagnostics.
